proof:
Source: parent proof, preliminary (G2), first assertion ("H(M ∖ spt X) = 0"), with (F4) = the hypothesis MF (the frozen statement of the parent's sibling fiw_im_mass_formula) and (G1) = the sibling vanish_off_support.

Notation. H := μHE[n] on ℝ^P. Z := zeroRegion(T), an open set (a union of open sets). spt T = U ∖ Z.

1. Let V := U ∩ Z; V is open because U and Z are open. Since M ⊆ U (IsRectifiableTriple.subset), M ∖ spt T = M ∖ (U ∖ Z) = M ∩ Z = M ∩ V.
2. M_V(T) = 0. By definition T.massOn V = sSup {ofReal(T ω) : ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn U n V}. If ω is admissible then tsupport ω ⊆ V ⊆ Z, and Z is disjoint from spt T = U ∖ Z; so tsupport ω and spt T are disjoint and T(ω) = 0 by the sibling vanish_off_support. Thus every element of the set equals ofReal 0 = 0, and the supremum is 0 (sSup_le).
3. Apply MF with these P, n, U (open), T, the triple (M, θ, ξ) and the hypothesis T = τ(M, θ, ξ) on D^n(U), and with the open set W := V. It gives ∫⁻_{M∩V} ofReal(θ x) dH(x) = T.massOn V = 0.
4. Exhaust U by compact sets: there are compact sets K_k ⊆ U (k ∈ ℕ) with ⋃_k K_k = U. (For instance K_k := closedBall(0, k) if U = ℝ^P, and otherwise K_k := {x : ‖x‖ ≤ k and infDist(x, ℝ^P ∖ U) ≥ 1/(k+1)}, which is closed and bounded, hence compact, and contained in U; every x ∈ U has positive distance to the closed set ℝ^P ∖ U, so it lies in some K_k.) Put S_k := M ∩ V ∩ K_k.
5. Fix k. K_k is a compact subset of U, so by IsRectifiableTriple.integrableOn θ is H-integrable on M ∩ K_k; in particular θ, and hence x ↦ ofReal(θ x), is a.e.-measurable for H⌞S_k (S_k ⊆ M ∩ K_k). By monotonicity of the lower integral in the set (lintegral_mono_set), ∫⁻_{S_k} ofReal θ dH ≤ ∫⁻_{M∩V} ofReal θ dH = 0. By lintegral_eq_zero_iff', ofReal(θ x) = 0 for H⌞S_k-a.e. x. But θ > 0 on M (IsRectifiableTriple.pos), so ofReal(θ x) ≠ 0 for every x ∈ S_k; hence S_k ⊆ {x : ofReal(θ x) ≠ 0}, which has H⌞S_k-measure 0, and H(S_k) = (H⌞S_k)(S_k) = 0 (Measure.restrict_apply_self and monotonicity).
6. M ∩ V ⊆ U = ⋃_k K_k, so M ∩ V = ⋃_k S_k and H(M ∩ V) ≤ Σ_k H(S_k) = 0 (measure_iUnion_null). By step 1, H(M ∖ spt T) = 0. ∎

Remark (optional shortcut for step 4). The comparator-accepted Submission.cmb_exists_compactly_contained_exhaustion (commit cb89cc7f436bbfa9b474f73003fa9aa79ebad102) gives open W_k ⊂⊂ U such that every compact subset of U lies in some W_k; applied to singletons, K_k := closure W_k is a compact exhaustion of U as required in step 4. Its Lean proof may be adapted under a fresh name.
key_steps: V := U ∩ zeroRegion(T) is open and M ∖ spt T = M ∩ V because M ⊆ U.
Every admissible form supported in V is killed by T (vanish_off_support), so M_V(T) = 0.
MF with W := V gives ∫⁻_{M∩V} θ dH^n = 0.
On each piece S_k = M ∩ V ∩ K_k of a compact exhaustion of U, θ is a.e.-measurable and positive, so H^n(S_k) = 0.
Countable subadditivity gives H^n(M ∖ spt T) = H^n(M ∩ V) = 0.
